name: Verified B2B Lead Lists (200-lead batch)
description:
Verified B2B lead database built to your exact criteria: decision-maker titles, verified business emails, deduped against your base, CSV/Sheets in 6 days. 200-lead batch, one revision round. Secure Gumroad checkout before delivery. No conversion promises.

WHAT YOU GET:
- 200 leads matched to the criteria you provide (titles, industries, geography, company size)
- Verified business emails per lead, checked before delivery
- Deduplication against the base list you supply
- Delivery as CSV and Google Sheets within 6 days of confirmed criteria
- One revision round after delivery

WHO THIS IS FOR:
- Founders and sales leads doing their own outbound
- Small B2B teams without a list-building hire
- Anyone who wants a defined batch with a revision, not an open-ended subscription

HOW IT WORKS:
1. You send your criteria and your existing base for dedup
2. The list is built and verified within 6 days
3. You receive CSV/Sheets, review, and request one revision round if needed
4. You check out securely via Gumroad and receive the delivery

LIMITATIONS:
Verification reflects the check date; roles and addresses change over time. Email deliverability also depends on your own sender setup (authentication, volume, list hygiene). This is a verified list, not a conversion promise — no meetings, replies, or revenue outcome is stated or implied. Effectiveness depends on your offer, targeting, and follow-up.
